name: A Game
source:
Short, sweet, rough and offensive... you follow this particular guy in his daily life while trying to maintain sanity by keeping his intolerance level in-check while building up strength and saving up money to make life easier. 

[From[url=http://www.renai.us/game/a_game.shtml] Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
